checkpoints.name: violated_run_verdict
checkpoints.description: At 1000 MHz the run completes and reports that its one clock falls short: a finding about the design, not a failed run. The achieved frequency is about 60.9 MHz.

checkpoints.name: met_run_verdict
checkpoints.description: The same design at 12 MHz meets its clock: the achieved frequency is the same, only the constraint moved.

checkpoints.name: worst_path_register_and_statement
checkpoints.description: The worst path of the violated run starts at src_a (or src_b) and ends at sum_q, and sum_q is computed on line 16 of src/path_adder.v by the 24-bit add.
